sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, raw x/y centroid, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/royal-caribbean/voyager-of-the-seas/v2462/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape[data-cabin] element per stateroom (rect, polygon or path; path commands resolved to absolute coordinates for the centroid). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to Royal Caribbean stateroom categories, anchored by known cabin numbers pulled from cruisedeckplans.com category-detail pages and cross-checked against per-category counts.

notes.completeness: FULL grid: every stateroom on every guest deck (decks 2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12), 1715 cabins total. RE-EXTRACTION VERIFICATION: deckmaps' Voyager index publishes 15 decks (2-15); its own per-deck counts are 2:108, 3:79, 4:0, 5:0, 6:337, 7:333, 8:331, 9:269, 10:161, 11:38, 12:59, 13:0, 14:0, 15:0 = 1715, matching this extraction deck-for-deck. Deck 14 IS now explicitly included and checked: its live v2462 SVG (deck-14.7916a780c1e2.svg, HTTP 200) contains ZERO .cabinShape[data-cabin] elements and no cabin-number labels - it is the pool/sports deck outline only. Decks 4, 5, 13, 15 were likewise fetched and confirmed to carry 0 staterooms. The authoritative Widgety figure of ~1,800 staterooms is a booking/inventory count that does NOT match deckmaps' plotted cabin geometry (deckmaps advertises and plots exactly 1,715, and places no cabins on deck 14); the ~85-cabin gap is a source discrepancy, not missing deck-14 data. No cabins were fabricated to close it. cruisedeckplans.com lists ~1,708-1,710 staterooms, also close to 1,715 (small differences are accessible/duplicate rows counted differently). The often-quoted ~1,557 figure is the pre-amplification/older count.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 29 distinct fills map to 14 Royal Caribbean categories (most categories use 1-5 colour shades). Every fill was anchored to a category by at least one confirmed cabin number from cruisedeckplans.com. See colorLegend.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Length axis is the SVG y-axis (bow at low y, confirmed by the forward-only suite/panoramic decks 11-12 sitting at low y); section = forward/mid/aft thirds of the global hull length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Per-deck geometric split of the beam (SVG x-axis) into two rows, low x = port / high x = starboard, assuming a standard viewed-from-above deck plan with bow forward. Could be uniformly mirrored; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction, not asserted as clear-view).
